reason: Tab never reaches the marker cell for row 10: the walk goes from the Select all rows checkbox through the column headers to each row's chevron button, and the focus probe ends on body. The per-row Select row 10 checkbox inside the cell is display:none until the pointer hovers it, and focusing the row's chevron does not reveal it. Keyboard users can select every row or edit one transaction through its detail drawer, but cannot pick a few rows for the bulk bar (date, description, ledger account), so the task is possible but hard: medium.

The gear icon button at the top right of the account header is exposed as button "" with no name, so 4.1.2 fails. It is visible and focusable, and it opens the Account settings dialog (rename, opening balance, Delete account), so screen-reader users cannot tell what it does before they activate it. It is not a form control or the page's primary action, so it stays medium.

The Reconciliation years combobox has autocomplete="garbage", a deliberate autofill opt-out. It picks which year of statements to show, not information about the user, so no listed input purpose applies, and the tree still exposes combobox "Reconciliation years" with its states.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose applies only to fields that collect information about the user and serve a purpose in the WCAG input-purpose list (name, email, address, card number and so on). The Reconciliation years combobox chooses which year of reconciliations to list, so it has no listed purpose and 1.3.5 cannot fail. 4.1.2 is met because the field exposes role combobox, name Reconciliation years and the expanded and haspopup states (see the ax probe). 4.1.1 Parsing no longer exists in WCAG 2.2, so an invalid token is only an HTML conformance error.
